primary_contrast: uncertainty-severity minus random in total cost-adjusted loss
episode_dependence: Independent scripted episodes; cross-agent traces are linked within an episode, not autonomous agents. The two variants share the same statistical generator and seed draws: they are semantic views of one test, not independent replications.
scope: Inert protocol demonstration. Trusted observations are supplied by the evaluator-owned simulated broker. One-round measurement allocation precedes scoring. This does not test adaptive attackers, live infrastructure, or prove that a system would have prevented the Hugging Face incident. Publish all conditions regardless of direction.
